summary_en: ¥52.00/share annual dividend for FY3/27 (¥26.00 interim + ¥26.00 year-end), up from ¥40.00 (¥20.00 each). Interim and year-end dividends increase 30%. Progressive dividend policy affirmed (no dividend cuts in principle). Shareholder gift program redesigned: ¥6,000 electronic gift for 1-year continuous holders (200+ shares), reduced from ¥12,000; non-holders eliminated. Gift program effective from FY3/27 dividend (record date 31 March 2027).
title_en: Notice on Revision of Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase) and Partial Changes to Shareholder Gift Program
translation_en_brief: On 13 August 2026, Fabrica Holdings' board resolved to increase its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending 31 March 2027 and restructure its shareholder gift program. The annual dividend will rise to ¥52.00 per share—¥26.00 for the interim dividend (record date 30 September 2026) and ¥26.00 for the year-end dividend (record date 31 March 2027)—up from the prior forecast of ¥40.00 (¥20.00 each). This represents a 30% increase to both interim and year-end payouts. The company affirms a progressive dividend policy, in principle avoiding dividend cuts and maintaining or raising the dividend level. The shareholder gift program, previously uniform regardless of share count, will be restructured effective from the 31 March 2027 dividend onwards. Shareholders holding 200+ shares continuously for one year or longer will receive an annual electronic gift of ¥6,000 (reduced from ¥12,000); shareholders holding fewer than one year will no longer be eligible. The 30 September 2026 dividend will operate under the prior program terms. The revision reflects the company's decision to centre shareholder returns on dividends rather than flat-rate gifts, ensuring returns proportional to shareholding. No impact on FY3/27 earnings guidance.
